language.description: Language for syntax highlighting, e.g. "python" or "c".

source.description: Source code of the algorithm. When present, each step's `meta.line` must be a line of this code.

propertyNames.description: Identifier of a structure, e.g. "arr" or "dist". Letters, digits and underscores; must not start with a digit; must not be a built-in JavaScript property name such as "constructor" or "__proto__".

view.description: How to draw the array: "row" (default) or "tree", a complete binary tree where index i has children 2i+1 and 2i+2, as for heaps.

id.description: Identifier of an element, unique within its structure and stable for the whole trace.

value.description: A displayable value: number, string, boolean or null.

items.description: An element with an explicit id.

initial.description: Initial contents: either bare values like [5, 3, 8] (ids "e0", "e1", … are generated) or elements like [{ "id": "a", "value": 5 }].
